validity.researcher_notes: TETCO verified as major interstate transmission system operated by Enbridge. Status, fuel, type, location, operator, and owner all confirmed via Enbridge InfoPost and 2025 Energy Infrastructure factsheet. Material discrepancies found in two specs: (1) Length: sheet 14,202 km vs Enbridge 8,532 miles ≈ 13,727 km (475 km / 3.5% difference); reflects possible inclusion of laterals in sheet vs mainline in factsheet. (2) Capacity: sheet 11,690 MMcf/d vs Enbridge '>12 Bcf/d' (>12,000 MMcf/d), 310 MMcf/d / 2.6% difference. Both within ~3.5% rounding range. StartYear1 1942 not confirmed in current research; construction and pressure data not sourced.

ConstructionYear blank. For 1942-operational system, construction 1941-1942. Not in Enbridge sources, SEC Edgar, or EIA. FERC Certificate or Order would state construction date. Need: FERC CP docket or historical Commission Order.
Pressure (MAOP) blank. Varies by segment over 14,000+ km system. FERC Form 2 or tariff Schedule would provide. Enbridge InfoPost does not expose pressure publicly.
FuelSource blank. TETCO is common-carrier multi-source system (Texas, Gulf Coast, Appalachia supply). No single fuel source. Cell blank is appropriate for multi-origin system row.

SegmentCost blank. Mainline built 1942; total cost not publicly available. EIA expansion projects show individual modernization costs ($112M-$1B ea). Without specific project scope, cost cannot be filled.

Diameter blank. System has multiple segments with varying diameters (16"-42"). No single value represents entire mainline. FERC Form 2 or tariff Schedule C would list segment diameters. EIA expansions show specific addition diameters but not baseline.
